description: Ask questions in natural language and receive source-backed answers based on your business documents, in a secure and confidential environment.
corpora: Analyse document collections such as contracts, procedures, technical documentation, financial reports, audit files and internal reference materials.
invalidCredentials: Invalid credentials. Check your email and password.
demoPrompt: Would you like to discover RAGatm?
rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in about {seconds} seconds.
rateLimitedNoDelay: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
accountLocked: Account temporarily locked after several attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
networkError: Unable to reach the server. Check your network and try again.
mfaIntro: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app.
mfaCodeHint: A backup code provided by an administrator is also accepted.

mfaSetupSubmit: Turn on and access my workspace
heroSubtitle: RAGatm transforms your content into actionable knowledge through document analysis, retrieval and artificial intelligence.
heroA11y: Illustration of how RAGatm works: documents are ingested, their visuals analysed, then turned into semantic representations and indexed in an access-controlled space. A question triggers a retrieval and a reranking of passages; the language model then writes an answer from those passages only, citing its sources.
